author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary:
ध्यानवत्स्वपि तारतम्यमाह ॥  योगिनामिति ।  सर्वेषामपि योगिनां मध्ये श्रद्धाशब्दोदितभक्तिमान्यः स युक्तो मतः ।  तत्रापि भक्तिमत्स्वपि यो मां भजते सेवेते स युक्ततरः ।  तत्रापि मद्गतेनांतरात्मना मद्गतांतःकरणेन 
फलकामनां विना भजते स युक्ततमो मत इति ।  योगिष्वप्युत्तम इति मे मतः ॥ ६.४७ ॥
translation:
Even of all the Yogis he is considered by Me to be the foremost Yogi, who worships Me with faith, with his mind and heart centred in Me (47)
V. Shraddha or faith is Bhakti. He who has faith is considered Vukta i.e., a Yogi. He who worships Me with Bhakti is a greater Yogi. And he who without attachment to fruits with perfect resignation and faith worships me is the foremost of Yogis. Such is the distinction intended by the superlative affix in Vuktatama.
